data.name: Another Level
data.detailed_description:
Complete challenging levels on single-player or multiplayer (2-4 players). Players can complete the game from level 1. Also, players can freely choose all unlocked levels from the start. Gameplay is easy as you can think of a casual game just completing on each level, but do not forget this is Another Level game that is different from usual levels. Good luck!

Random gameplay :

Unique and different gameplay for some levels. There will be interesting gameplay that players may have never experienced before.

Multiplayer playing with friend : 

Complete challenging levels with a friend (2-4 players). Those who knock out first will be watching other players until they finish the level. The game will restart level once all players have lost.

Challenging and unique level : 

The levels might be hard or easy with unique and good seeing graphics. There are some strange platforms or level that can make players lose from the game.
